brand.name: Anomaly Box
brand.tagline: Private Creative Direction & Shoot Briefs for Instagram Creators
brand.short_bio: Private Instagram shoot briefs with scene flow, spoken lines, camera angles, and edit notes. Built for creators who refuse generic AI slop.
brand.full_bio: Anomaly Box provides private creative direction and campaign-ready shoot briefs for Instagram creators, brands, and agency operators. Instead of generic prompt generators and AI slop, Anomaly Box delivers structured creative dossiers (Classic Red & Signature Purple) directly to the creator's secure digital vault. Each brief covers hook options, scene-by-scene timing, camera angles, spoken dialogue, on-screen text systems, and anti-claim boundaries to eliminate decision fatigue on set.
